preconditions.expression: t == int(t) and t >= 1 and t <= 400
preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 400 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and n >= 4 and n <= 65536 and (n & (n - 1)) == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != '' for n, k in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is a power of 2 between 4 and 65536 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(k == int(k) and k >= 0 and k <= n - 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != '' for n, k in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, k is an integer between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout.strip() == '-1' for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != '') or all(any((a == int(a) and b == int(b) and a != b and 0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n) for a, b in [pair.split()] if pair.strip() != '') and sum(int(a) & int(b) for pair in pairs for a, b in [pair.split()]) == k for pairs in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i + n//2]] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), n//2) for n, k in [stdin.splitlines()[j+1].split()] for j in range(len(stdin.splitlines())-1) if j == i//(n//2))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a solution exists, output n/2 pairs of distinct elements from 0 to n-1 such that the sum of their bitwise ANDs equals k. Otherwise, output -1.
